title: Locale-adaptive rescorer hedging and canary protocol for cross-encoder upgrades
creator: Priya Rao
description: Goal: Implement a locale-adaptive rescorer variant selection + hedging strategy and a standardized canary protocol to safely upgrade cross-encoder rerank models across locales without regressing relevance or exceeding tail-latency SLOs. Scope includes model gating logic, lightweight locale detector integration, canary traffic routing (per-locale splits), regression harness expansions, per-locale telemetry, and automated rollback triggers. Out of scope: retraining embeddings backbone or altering semantic search index format.
acceptance_criteria: Can deploy new cross-encoder variants behind a variant-gating layer which selects models per-request based on locale hint and latency budget
Can perform per-locale canary rollouts with configurable traffic fractions and automated rollback when quality or latency gates breach thresholds
Regression harness extended with locale-stratified testsets and synthetic perturbations; nightly runs produce a per-locale quality delta report and flag regressions > 1.5% absolute NDCG drop
End-to-end latency P95 and P99 per-locale are captured and compared to baseline; cannot exceed configured latency budget in >1% of canary traffic
Documentation for the hedging policy and rollout playbook published with test checklist and SRE escalation steps
updates: 2025-02-19: Kickoff meeting with PM, Design, and SRE. Agreed hedging approach: default to lightweight locale model for tail-latency sensitive locales and spike up to high-quality cross-encoder when latency budget permits.
2025-02-24: Prototype gating lambda implemented (locale detection + budget check). Local benchmark shows 20% cost reduction for GA locale set at 10ms additional latency headroom.

2025-03-03: Expanded regression harness with 12 new locale testsets and adversarial typos; initial run flagged en_US variant for subtle reordering issues (investigating data preprocessing differences).

2025-03-07: Design review notes: add token-level breakdown to telemetry and a canary dashboard tile showing quality / latency joint distribution. Design approved by Sarah Kim (PM) and Aisha Fernando (SRE).
2025-03-09: Created draft playbook for canary -> regional ramp -> global rollout with explicit rollback triggers (quality drop, P99 latency increase, error rate spike). Needs SRE sign-off.
2025-03-10: Opened initial GitHub PR for gating + telemetry: github.com/redwood-inference/rerank/PR-8342. Added integration tests and mock locale routing. Awaiting code review from eng lead.
